summary: Iteration 15 (Parental authorisation) — full backend + frontend end-to-end. All 7 pytest cases pass and all UI flows verified. Backend: POST /api/booking with minor:true & minor_consent:false → 400 with French detail (contains 'autorisation parentale'); minor:true + minor_consent:true → 200 with response.minor=true, minor_consent=true, parental_auth_received=null; minor omitted → 200 with minor=false. PATCH /api/admin/bookings/{id} {parental_auth_received:true|false} → returns the flag correctly. GET /api/admin/bookings exposes minor, minor_consent, parental_auth_received fields. Frontend (FR): booking-checkbox-minor unchecked by default, booking-minor-panel absent; checking → panel appears with notice containing '14 ans' and required booking-checkbox-minor-consent. Submit with CGV checked but minor-consent unchecked is blocked by HTML5 required validation (0 POST). Checking minor-consent → submit succeeds (1 POST /api/booking, ~10s). Unchecking booking-checkbox-minor hides the panel and resets minor_consent state (verified: after re-check the consent box is unchecked). EN i18n label = 'One or more participants are minors (14 to 17 years old)'. Admin: /admin/bookings displays booking-minor-toggle-{id} amber pill 'Mineur · autorisation à recevoir' on minor rows only (non-minor rows have no such badge). Clicking triggers toast 'Réservation mise à jour' and toggles the badge to emerald 'Mineur · autorisation reçue'; clicking again reverts to amber. All 4 test bookings created were cancelled at the end (no CA pollution).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py L255-256: minor/minor_consent validation is atomic and returns a clear French 400 detail — good. Consider also validating minor_consent is a bool via Pydantic (already covered by BookingCreate model).
BookingModal.jsx L171: onChange resets minor_consent to false when minor is toggled — correct UX. Consent field uses HTML5 required, so browser-side blocking works even without JS toast.

BookingsTable.jsx uses emerald-400 for received / amber-400 for pending — contrast is sufficient on dark bg. Toggle button is a proper <button> with data-testid={`booking-minor-toggle-${b.id}`} — testable.
GET /api/admin/bookings returns the three new fields on every row (verified via API). No _id leakage.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (8/8 scenarios: default unchecked, panel toggle, required consent blocks submit, POST after consent, uncheck resets consent, EN label, admin amber badge presence + non-minor absence, admin toggle amber↔emerald with toast)

seed_data_creation: 4 bookings created against delivered@resend.dev with date 2026-10-01 during testing (TEST Iter15 x2, TEST Iter15 UI, TEST Iter15 Admin, TEST Iter15 NonMinor, TEST Iter15 Admin2). All were PATCH'd to status=cancelled at end so stats/CA are not polluted.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Set REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL env var before running pytest (it is not exported in the shell by default). Run: REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL=https://canary-foil-club.preview.emergentagent.com python -m pytest backend/tests/test_iteration15_minor.py -v. The admin BookingsTable minor badge uses classes 'amber-400/50' (pending) vs 'emerald-400/40' (received) — check for 'amber' / 'emerald' substrings, not 'green'. booking-terms-checkbox is also required to submit the booking form. Cancelling test bookings must go via PATCH /api/admin/bookings/{id} {status:'cancelled'}.
